acceptance.given: Toolchain authority resolution is evaluated against repository-relative candidate paths and current-authority policy.

oracle.expected: Verification evidence shows the resolver selects an approved repository authority and explicitly rejects any user-profile path as current authority.
forbidden: A user-profile path is selected or treated as current authority.
Authority selection relies on an unverified profile location.
oracle.observable: A deterministic validator result records selected authority path, rejected profile candidates, and policy decision.

acceptance.then: Current authority is resolved without treating user-profile paths as authoritative.
acceptance.when: When resolving or selecting current authority.

failure_intents.selector_intent: Run the authority-resolution validator with a user-profile candidate bound as the proposed current authority; it must fail and identify the profile path as prohibited.

slice_hint.behavior_change: Enforce authority resolution to accept only approved repository-relative authority paths; explicitly reject user-profile paths and report the rejected candidate in deterministic validation evidence.

rollback_scope.state_or_schema_compatibility: Preserve existing authority result schema and fail closed for newly detected profile-path candidates; rollback only these validator changes.

slice_hint.state_transition: pending -> authority validator executes -> profile candidate rejected -> approved repository authority recorded.
slice_hint.terminal_predicate: Validator output contains an approved repository-relative current authority, a deterministic rejection for every user-profile candidate, and no profile path in the selected authority field.

acceptance.given: A matrix aggregate is evaluated with at least one matrix evidence artifact marked stale or outside its freshness boundary.

oracle.expected: The aggregate result is deterministically marked invalid, with stale evidence identified as the cause.
forbidden: The aggregate is marked valid while any required matrix evidence is stale.
Stale evidence is silently ignored or replaced by historical evidence.
oracle.observable: Aggregate validation output includes status invalid and a stale-evidence diagnostic tied to the affected matrix case.

acceptance.then: 汇总结果被判定为无效。
acceptance.when: When evaluating the aggregate after freshness validation detects stale matrix evidence.

failure_intents.selector_intent: Feed the aggregate validator a stale matrix evidence fixture and assert the validator rejects any valid aggregate outcome.

slice_hint.behavior_change: Aggregate computation must apply freshness checks to every required matrix evidence item and force invalid status when any item is stale, while preserving a diagnostic naming the stale case.

rollback_scope.state_or_schema_compatibility: Keep aggregate result fields backward compatible; rollback limited to freshness-gate logic and diagnostics.

slice_hint.state_transition: stale evidence supplied -> freshness validation -> aggregate invalid with stale diagnostic.
slice_hint.terminal_predicate: For any required stale matrix evidence, validator exits with an invalid aggregate status and identifies the stale artifact; no valid aggregate is emitted.

acceptance.given: The evaluation-seed manifest contains the three named seed occurrences required by FR-6.

oracle.expected: Each occurrence appears exactly once and has provenance, applicability, missing-label status, counterexample or explicit absence, and approved non-baseline classification.
forbidden: Any named seed occurrence is duplicated.
Any occurrence lacks provenance or required classification fields.
oracle.observable: A parsed manifest verification report lists all three seed identifiers once with complete provenance and classification fields.

acceptance.then: Every named evaluation-seed occurrence has provenance recorded.
acceptance.when: When each evaluation-seed occurrence is recorded or checked.

failure_intents.selector_intent: Run manifest validation against a fixture with one named evaluation seed missing provenance; validation must fail and identify that occurrence.

slice_hint.behavior_change: Validate the seed manifest bidirectionally for exactly three named occurrences and require provenance plus applicability, missing labels, counterexample or explicit absence, and approved non-baseline classification on each.

rollback_scope.state_or_schema_compatibility: Preserve manifest schema compatibility; additive validation diagnostics only, with rollback scoped to seed-manifest checks.

slice_hint.state_transition: manifest parsed -> named occurrences counted -> provenance/classification fields checked -> verification report emitted.
slice_hint.terminal_predicate: Verification report confirms exactly three required seed occurrences, each unique and complete; any duplicate or missing provenance causes deterministic failure.

acceptance.given: A candidate validator for FR-3 is available for inspection together with its declared source and contract metadata.

oracle.expected: An independent verification run checks validator content against its declared requirements and records a passing verification result.
forbidden: Validator content is accepted without independent verification.
The validator self-attests correctness without an external content check.
oracle.observable: Independent validator report contains source/content hashes, required-rule checks, and a pass/fail decision separate from the candidate validator's own output.

acceptance.then: Validator content has an independent verification result.
acceptance.when: When validating the candidate validator for FR-3.

failure_intents.selector_intent: Provide validator content that omits a required FR-3 rule or mismatches its declared source; the independent verifier must fail and report the missing or mismatched rule.

slice_hint.behavior_change: Add or invoke an independent content verifier that parses the candidate validator, checks source/hash and required FR-3 rules, and emits a separate deterministic verification report.

rollback_scope.state_or_schema_compatibility: Retain existing validator invocation and result schema; independent report is additive and rollback is limited to verifier integration.

slice_hint.state_transition: candidate validator loaded -> independent source/content checks -> verification report pass or fail.
slice_hint.terminal_predicate: Independent verification report exists, includes source/content rule checks, and passes only when all required FR-3 validator semantics are present.
